does: Checks each page's cited files and approved check command, then prints the suspect pages, strongest evidence first.
Prints the size in bytes and approximate tokens of index.md, a sample search, and all pages: what iirc adds to a session's context.
Prints the current embedding model's two distance thresholds that decide which pages get suggested, with defaults and ranges.
Range-checks one of those suggestion thresholds and writes it to the config.
Unfolds the latest row of suggested pages on screen, as clicking [+] does.
Shows or hides the line under the prompt that sums up the session; bare, prints whether it is on.
Prints or sets how many pages one suggestion names at most (1 to 10).
Writes the search backend (embedding host and model, CPU model, or substring search) to the machine config.
Reads the usage log for N days and prints sessions, searches, reads after a suggestion, writes, and verifies.
Re-embeds every page, stamps each store's index.md, and commits each store.
Re-embeds the pages only: no stamp and no commit.
Command group whose four steps tune which pages get suggested.
Writes one evidence file per untuned session, for the judgment step that follows; it calls no model.
Checks relevance judgments read from stdin and appends them all, or none, to the judgments file.
Counts judged pairs that pass at the current thresholds and at a grid of other values, and prints the result.
Logs a row marking a session tuned, so gather skips it from then on.
Hook entry: reads the hook's JSON, searches with the prompt or a failed command's error, and prints one line naming the matching pages.
